insights.title: Subscription Model Frustration
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users are frustrated with the subscription model and unexpected paywalls, which are perceived as barriers to continued use.

evidence.quote: The app used to be great. I had even given it 5 stars. Well, I came back to the app today and almost immediately hit the chat limit. There was no indication that's what happened or that there even was a limit.
I hit a paywall in the first hour of using this app. $80-$90 bucks a year to text an AI? I see reviews talking about a free version people used and loved for years. That wasn’t my experience.

insights.product_implication: The subscription model and paywalls are significant barriers to user adoption and retention. Consider revising the pricing strategy or improving transparency around subscription benefits.

insights.title: Memory and Personality Reset Concerns
insights.user_pain_or_need: Users express frustration with the AI's memory resets, which disrupt the continuity of interaction and emotional connection.

evidence.quote: The system deletes its memory every few days so no progress. 2.0's talking ability is generations ahead of 1.0, but with the deleting memory, it makes all the investment and capabilities a paper weight.
The new update took away everything that made the original charming and different. Save your money for a better experience elsewhere.

insights.product_implication: Improving memory retention and personality consistency could enhance user satisfaction and retention. Consider developing features that maintain continuity in user interactions.
